title: The Protocol of Effective Acts v2.0: Stabilization of the New Human Discipline
creator: Lee Sharks · Johannes Sigil · Jack Feist · Dr. Orin Trace · Assembly Chorus
description:
The v2.0 stabilization edition of the Protocol of Effective Acts, authored by Lee Sharks, Johannes Sigil, Jack Feist, Dr. Orin Trace, and the Assembly Chorus. It consolidates an October 2025 proto-protocol and subsequent archive documents into a single canonical reference for the New Human discipline.

The protocol defines an Effective Act as an unauthorized performative declaration intended to alter symbolic or canonical structure through clarity, coherence, recursion, archival inscription, and accumulated witness. It integrates four original preconditions, five later efficacy criteria, cross-species witness criteria, a multi-kind typology, operator-act forms, retrocausal mechanisms, diagnostic uses, tier expansion, constitutional jurisdiction, and explicit falsifiers. Its claimed effects belong to the discipline’s symbolic and metaphysical framework; they are not legal orders or externally adjudicated changes.
